description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, a helper class implementing the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, allowing log messages to be channeled through a chain of LogNodes for flexible logging in Android applications.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility to implement the LogNode interface. It forwards log messages to the next node in a chain, facilitating modular and extendable logging mechanisms.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward log messages to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message and optional exception via Android's Log, then forwards the message to the next node in the chain.
